ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (off-white/light-grey) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant light-intensity field with dark contiguous banding along the trailing and lateral edges. A distinct cluster of dark vertical linear marks is localized on the medial-to-distal region of the right lobe. Dark mottled pigmentation is concentrated at the junction of the lobes and the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 105 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys along the trailing boundary. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a higher density of small-scale serrations compared to the relatively smoother profile of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a distinct concave curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple high-contrast linear pixel disruptions. Left lobe: one prominent dark diagonal scratch extending from the mid-section towards the trailing edge. Right lobe: a series of at least four parallel dark vertical 'rake' marks in the central interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of distinct rake marks on both the left and right lobes; no evidence of gross physical trauma or amputations on the visible fluke margins.
